description: This file defines interfaces and data classes related to the Orleans reminder table system. It includes the IReminderTable interface which abstracts storage operations such as reading, updating, and removing reminders, along with related data structures like ReminderTableData and ReminderEntry.

classes.name: ReminderTableData
classes.description: Represents a collection of reminder entries, with constructors for different initialization scenarios.

classes.name: ReminderEntry
classes.description: Encapsulates the data for a single reminder, including grain ID, reminder name, start time, period, and ETag.

classes.name: ReminderData
classes.description: Immutable class implementing IGrainReminder, representing a reminder's core data.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table, delegating to Init() method, with support for cancellation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Obsolete method for initialization, returns a completed task.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder table entries based on grain ID or range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry by grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry, returning the new ETag.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder entry identified by grain ID and reminder name, with ETag for concurrency control.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the entire reminder table; intended for testing.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the reminder table, supporting cancellation.
